entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Jane. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Aero-Sprint cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them?
They just don't work for me.
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you tell me a little more? For example, is there an issue with the fit, or maybe with getting the cleats attached properly?
They just hurt. I've tried everything, but they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels after every ride. It's impossible.

Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I understand why you'd want to return them. Let me just check the policy for you. I see the order was delivered about 43 days ago.
Okay, I've just consulted our return policy. And good news, it looks like these cycling shoes are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file right now. Just pack the shoes up, and you can drop them off at any post office. Also, Jane, I see here that you're a VIP member with VeloFit. I'm really sorry for the trouble with the fit, so as a thank you for your loyalty, I've added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase.
You're welcome. Once our warehouse receives the return, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
